_comment: Tools passed to Claude in brief chat. Built by ChatTools.definitions(). All read-only and bound to the brief's client (no clientId parameter). propose_brief_edit only proposes; the RM applies.

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: List the client's accounts with current and available balances.

direction.description: outflow = money out, inflow = money in

min_amount.description: Only transactions at least this large (absolute dollars)

limit.description: Max rows to return, 1-100 (default 25). Totals always cover every match.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Find the client's transactions with filters. Returns matching rows (newest first) plus totals computed over every match.

direction.description: outflow = money out, inflow = money in

tools.name: summarize_transactions
tools.description: Group the client's transactions and total them (by merchant, category, month or account). Use this instead of adding up numbers yourself.

direction.description: outflow = money out, inflow = money in

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Compare transaction totals between two date ranges; returns both totals, the difference and the percent change.

tools.name: get_liabilities
tools.description: Credit cards, mortgages and student loans.

tools.name: get_relationship_notes
tools.description: CRM context: last meeting notes, segment, tenure, products such as CDs, and tracked promises with due status.

action.description: ADD a new item, REPLACE an existing one, or REMOVE one

index.description: 0-based index of the item to REPLACE or REMOVE, as listed in the brief

text.description: New item text for ADD or REPLACE

severity.description: Watch-out severity (required when adding a watch-out)

citations.description: IDs supporting the item (accountId, transactionId, productType or promiseId). Required except for talkingPoints and REMOVE.

reason.description: One sentence the RM sees explaining why

tools.name: propose_brief_edit
tools.description: Propose one change to the brief. The RM sees it and decides whether to apply it; it is never applied automatically. Call once per change.
